instructions: Everything here is fictional. Use only the cast and details on the card, never real names, numbers or places from your own life.
Speak, don't read. Glance at the details, then dictate the way you normally would. Order and wording are up to you.
Don't fix your own mistakes by retaking. Stumbles, restarts and 'um's are the data. Retake only if the recording itself failed.
Follow the delivery cues. They make sure each disfluency or interruption type shows up enough times across the set.
Hold the phone the way you do when dictating normally, in a normal room. No studio conditions.
